24 (26) |campaign = Prophecies |campaign2 = Factions |campaign3 = Nightfall }}__NOTOC__ [[Torment Claw]]s are large claws that reach up from the ground. They are usually found near rifts from the [[Realm of Torment]] into the mortal world or in the Realm itself. Torment Claws are immobile and only possess melee range attacks, and are thus defenseless to ranged attacks; their only dangerous attack, [[Torment Slash]], can also be avoided by staying behind or away from them. ==Locations== *[[Prophecies]] **[[Kryta]] ***{{NPC location|Lion's Arch (Sunspears in Kryta)}} (level 22, during [[Sunspears in Kryta]]) *[[Factions]] **[[Kaineng City]] ***{{NPC location|Kaineng Center (Sunspears in Cantha)}} (level 22, only during [[Sunspears in Cantha]]) *[[Nightfall]] **[[Istan]] ***{{NPC location|Kamadan, Jewel of Istan (explorable area)}} (only during [[Bad Tide Rising]]) **[[The Desolation]] ***{{NPC location|Joko's Domain}} (only during [[A Deal's a Deal]]) **[[Realm of Torment]] ***{{NPC location|Domain of Fear}} ***{{NPC location|Domain of Secrets}} ***{{NPC location|Nightfallen Jahai}} ***[[Domain of Anguish]] ****{{NPC location|Ravenheart Gloom}} ****{{NPC location|Stygian Veil}} ==Missions== *Factions **[[Shing Jea Island]] (only during [[Dragon Festival 2006]]) ***{{NPC location|Haiju Lagoon (mission)}} ***{{NPC location|Jaya Bluffs (mission)}} ***{{NPC location|Tsumei Village (mission)}} ***{{NPC location|Seitung Harbor (mission)}} ***{{NPC location|Shing Jea Monastery (mission)}} *Nightfall **[[Vabbi]] ***{{NPC location|Grand Court of Sebelkeh}} **Realm of Torment ***{{NPC location|Abaddon's Gate}} ***{{NPC location|Gate of Madness}} ==Skills== *{{monster skill icon|Fingers of Chaos}} *{{monster skill icon|Torment Slash}} ==Armor ratings== {{NPC statistics | level = 24 | prof = w | blunt = 71 | piercing = 71 | slashing = 71 | cold = 71 | earth = 71 | fire = 71 | lightning = 71 }} ==Items dropped== *[[Demonic Relic]] *[[Torment Gemstone]] ==Notes== *Torment Claws in the [[Domain of Anguish]] have innate +2 [[health regeneration]]
